source_identity_correction.finding: The selected 24 task IDs are exactly the second half of the V4/V5 error pool and are not untouched new families.

primary_comparison: localization_feedback versus ordinary_retry on wrong_to_correct and correct_to_wrong

decision_rule.continue_feedback_repair: On this reused development panel, localization must repair at least one initial error without more correct-to-wrong transitions than ordinary retry and must improve the delivery risk-coverage tradeoff.
decision_rule.stop_current_repair_representation: No wrong-to-correct gain, or more correct-to-wrong than repaired, or no risk-coverage improvement after accounting for cost.
decision_rule.boundary: Twenty-four reused error-pool families support development replay only. No significance, new-family confirmation or general cross-report claim is supported.

hidden_reference_use: Evaluation and variant expected values only; no hidden answer, program, or reference set is placed in prompts or policy features.
